== Summary ==
Identified: [[Ray Bordier]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Another shot of [[Ray Bordier|Ray]] - Bordier touches his tongue to the bill of his cap. A regular Gene Simmons." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
